done_when: forge merge keeps waiting on checks and prints its Merged line, with its start-to-merge time, even when the task folder is removed during the check wait.
why: merge.py passes the task worktree as the top argument to checks.wait, and checks._ask runs every gh api call with cwd set to it, so subprocess raises FileNotFoundError once that folder is gone; the code after the wait also reads the task folder (story.show, close._pull_request, time_records.merge_line and git rev-parse), so those reads need the same care.
